title: P3: packet-glint ghost-dim path (glint alpha follows body.a under focus) is untested
detail: Both glints (lines 1083, 1093) are only covered at body.a=255: capture_frame hardcodes focus_class=-1 and no demo verb drives focus. A regression to a fixed-alpha glint (ghost packets render full-bright) passes every gate.
recommended_fix: Add a demo verb (or palcheck leg) that captures a frame with focus_class set while off-class packets are in flight, blessing it as the ghost-dim golden.
